# Comparison C read as widening

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`comparison-by-widening` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F07 · [record](comparison-by-widening.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> On level paths an extension with every claim counted is exactly a widening of what can form, so with “better” read as widening, C holds for every reading of living: C's normative content moves into calling widening better.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. On the frame of a web's level paths a claim is a formation at a step, realized along a level path where its levels admit the formation then, meeting every requirement it has at that step. One level path widens another where at every step it admits every formation the other admits, and at some step one more. (`Becoming.Web.paths`, `Becoming.Web.Admits`, `Becoming.Web.Includes`, `Becoming.Web.Exceeds`, `Becoming.Web.Widens`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* its declarations include the anchor `Becoming.Web.Widens` itself; widening; its declarations do not reach the grammar.
2. With every claim counted as living, an extension of one level path by another, realizing every claim the first realizes and one more, is exactly the second widening the first. (`Becoming.Extension`, `Becoming.Web.paths_extension_iff_widens`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* widening; its declarations do not reach the grammar; the measure counts central declaration `Becoming.Web.paths_extension_iff_widens` as following from a shared law (not reaching the grammar: C's extension on a web's paths: a reindexing of claims (formation, step) to admissions (step, formation), every claim counted; widening enters by its definition, its order laws already from the grammar).
   - *On its own carrier (declared; reviewed in [REVIEW-U3-LEAN.md](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/development/u3-significance-on-the-root/REVIEW-U3-LEAN.md)):* `Becoming.Web.paths_extension_iff_widens` is stated at the row's own carrier by `Becoming.SignificanceStatements.paths_extension_iff_grammar` (law 9 of this record).
   - *Standing of `Becoming.Web.paths_extension_iff_widens`, by the rule:* own carrier (F5's verified items on its own carrier only).
3. For every reading of living, C, every extension being better, holds on level paths with “better” read as widening; the proof unfolds the comparison to the extension, so that widening is better is supplied by the reading of “better”. (`Becoming.Comparison`, `Becoming.Web.paths_comparison_widens`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* widening; its declarations do not reach the grammar.
   - *On its own carrier (declared; reviewed in [REVIEW-U3-LEAN.md](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/development/u3-significance-on-the-root/REVIEW-U3-LEAN.md)):* `Becoming.Web.paths_comparison_widens` is stated at the row's own carrier by `Becoming.SignificanceStatements.paths_comparison_grammar` (law 10 of this record).
4. Widening is transitive and goes one way, and a widening is never a mixed pair, two level paths each exceeding the other. (`Becoming.Web.Widens.trans`, `Becoming.Web.Widens.not_reverse`, `Becoming.Web.Mixed`, `Becoming.Web.Widens.not_mixed`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* widening; its declarations reach the grammar.
5. Under the continuation condition, for every standpoint, one level path widens another exactly when it retains and adds what has significance from that standpoint. (`Becoming.Unrestricted`, `Becoming.Web.widens_iff_retains_adds`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* widening; its declarations do not reach the grammar; the measure counts central declaration `Becoming.Web.widens_iff_retains_adds` as following from a shared law (not reaching the grammar: the reduction of what has significance to what can form under the continuation condition; the free significance is not lifted to the root).
   - *Standing of `Becoming.Web.widens_iff_retains_adds`:* free significance, a reading: It takes the condition as a hypothesis with significance free, as chapter 7 intends; its root form, SignificanceStatements.widens_iff_retains_adds_root, holds at the own-closure reading only (U3) and states less than the row ([REVIEW-U4-RECORD.md](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/development/u4-one-root-to-its-edge/REVIEW-U4-RECORD.md)); the rule gives unplaced (none of the rule's tests holds).
6. On level paths, under the continuation condition, for every reading of living, living significance holds with relevance read as significance from every standpoint, and C holds with “better” read as retaining and adding what has significance from a given standpoint. (`Becoming.LivingSignificance`, `Becoming.Web.paths_livingSignificance_comparison`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
7. On level paths the continuation condition, living significance, extension and widening read one predicate, admission: the continuation condition holds exactly when living significance does with every claim living and significance from every standpoint as relevance; an extension with every claim counted is exactly a widening; under the condition, widening is retaining and adding from each standpoint. (`Becoming.Web.unrestricted_iff_paths_livingSignificance`, `Becoming.Web.paths_one_object`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* widening; its declarations do not reach the grammar; the measure counts central declaration `Becoming.Web.paths_one_object` as following from a shared law (not reaching the grammar: the conjunction of C's extension on paths, the continuation condition as living significance, and the reduction of significance under the condition).
   - *Standing of `Becoming.Web.paths_one_object`:* free significance, a reading: It keeps significance free, as chapter 7 intends; its root form, SignificanceStatements.paths_one_object_root, holds at the own-closure reading only (U3) and states less than the row ([REVIEW-U4-RECORD.md](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/development/u4-one-root-to-its-edge/REVIEW-U4-RECORD.md)); the rule gives unplaced (none of the rule's tests holds).
8. In a witness where a conveyor's part is withheld, each of the two level paths exceeds the other: without the part the first formation is admitted at every step and the second is not, while with it the second is supported from the second step on and the first is not. (`Becoming.Transfer.mixed`)

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- The frame of level paths (Web.paths): claims are pairs of a formation and a step, and a level path realizes one exactly when it admits the formation at that step; the comparison is between any two level paths.
- “Better” is read as widening what can form (Web.Widens); C is a theorem on this reading, and remains a premise where “better” is read otherwise or on a general frame.
- Discrete steps; natural-number levels and needs.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- On a general frame, or with “better” read otherwise, C is a premise, not a theorem.
- Widening leaves a mixed pair unordered either way; ordering mixed parts needs a measure, which is not given. Witness: `Becoming.Transfer.mixed`.
- That widening is better is not shown: C's normative content moves into calling widening better, where the condition's step of invariance becomes the content of calling the generative space good.
- **Counterexample:** Widening does not order every pair of level paths: the conveyor's part leaves the two paths mixed (Transfer.mixed, see four-cases-of-a-part). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Admission.lean)

**Standard boundaries:** States how significance relates to structure, for any significance or under the continuation condition (Unrestricted: the continuation of anything has significance); it asserts no significance and does not assert the condition. · Stated for discrete steps. · Names follow the structural naming criteria and are adopted only where the statement has their exact meaning; readings are interpretations, open to revision.

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

Ren asked on 11 October 2026: “can we reduce is "for anything, its continuation into the future leads to more futures(flourishes/plurality) from generatively" - so we can be like "these are space where generatively happens", which allows us to derive everything without axiom?” (provenance, not warrant). The AI's reading: widening reads “leads to more futures”, possibilities being what can form next; what can form now is the generative space, and where a part widens it is the region Ren's sentence names (D22, revised). “Flourishes/plurality” is read by widening (an AI reading), plurality an aspect not yet measured; widening compares what can form; 生生 is read since 9 November 2026 as the continuation of life, not as widening (D1). The condition fixes which admissions count, and C read as widening orders them (an AI reading).
